_about: Which open models the farm serves. Pick a profile with FARM_PROFILE (default: budget). Each model runs in its own vLLM server; the gateway (gateway.py) puts them all behind one OpenAI-compatible address with one key. 'hf' is the Hugging Face repo; farm.sh checks it exists before downloading and skips (with a warning) any it can't find, so a renamed repo never stops the others. 'mem' is the share of each GPU's memory the model may use; 'gpus' how many GPUs it spans (tensor parallel). 'fp8' quantises on the fly (Ada/Hopper GPUs: RTX 4090, L40S, H100…) — about half the memory, near-identical quality. 'tool_parser' turns on tool calling (agents need it); null means the model only chats/answers, which Hive handles (it won't give it agent work).

qwen3.8-27b.role: UI, learning animations (Nexora's scene format), motion code, everyday coding — the farm's main worker

qwen3-coder-next.role: Backend and agentic coding (multi-file changes, tests, refactors)

nemotron-cascade-2-30b.role: Maths and CS reasoning (GATE solutions, checking answers)

devstral-small-2.role: Design or screenshot to code (takes images); second-opinion reviewer from another model family

gemma-4-31b.role: Reviewer from a different family than the coders (catches more), maths

paddleocr-vl.role: Reading scanned GATE papers: text, tables and formulas

budget._hardware: 1 GPU with 48 GB (L40S, RTX 6000 Ada, A6000) — about $0.6-0.9/h. The main worker plus the small specialists.

plus._hardware: 1 GPU with 80 GB (A100 80GB, H100) — about $1.2-2/h. Adds the maths/reasoning specialist.

pro._hardware: 2 GPUs with 80 GB each — about $2.5-4/h. The whole team except the UI specialist.

ui._hardware: 1 GPU with 80 GB. For UI-heavy weeks: the main worker plus the UI specialist.
